changeSet.author: Pappas
changeSet.sql:
IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'dbo' AND TABLE_NAME = 'AssetDisplayValue') BEGIN CREATE TABLE [dbo].[AssetDisplayValue]( [AssetID] [bigint] NOT NULL, [DisplayValue] [nvarchar](max) NOT NULL, [DisplayValueHash] [nvarchar](50) NULL, [DisplayValuePrefix] [nvarchar](250) NOT NULL, [UpdatedOn] [datetime] CONSTRAINT [DF_AssetDisplayValue_UpdatedOn] DEFAULT (getutcdate()) NOT NULL, CONSTRAINT [PK_AssetDisplayValue] PRIMARY KEY NONCLUSTERED ( [AssetID] ASC ) ) END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.indexes where name = 'IX_AssetDisplayValue_DisplayValuePrefix_AssetID') BEGIN CREATE CLUSTERED INDEX [IX_AssetDisplayValue_AssetID] ON [dbo].[AssetDisplayValue] ( [AssetID] ASC ) END
IF NOT EXISTS ( select 1 from [sys].[fulltext_indexes] i inner join [sys].[objects] o on o.object_id = i.object_id and o.Name = 'AssetDisplayValue' ) BEGIN CREATE FULLTEXT INDEX ON dbo.AssetDisplayValue(DisplayValue) KEY INDEX PK_AssetDisplayValue ON fullTextCatalog END
